Care, made clear

Read the light

Place plants where the variety can receive the right intensity throughout the day.

Water with purpose

Check the soil first. Most roots prefer a thoughtful drink to a rigid schedule.

Watch new growth

New leaves are feedback. Adjust light and moisture as the seasons change.

Common questions

Before your plant arrives

Each plant is watered appropriately, secured in breathable protective packaging, and sent with tracking. Delivery timing is selected to reduce time in transit.

If your plant arrives damaged or declines because of a pre-existing health issue within 30 days, contact our care team with a photo and order details.

Yes. Every plant includes a concise care card covering light, watering, humidity, feeding, and the signs that help you read its needs.

Because plants are living goods, returns require a quick care-team review. Unopened accessories can be returned within 30 days in their original condition.
